Subject: SOC 2 / CAIQ intake — request to schedule kickoff

Hi Ethan,

We're starting the SOC 2 readiness assessment and the vendor team asked for a CAIQ/SIG intake for Redwood. Can we schedule a 45-minute kickoff next week to go over scope, log samples, and the questionnaire handoff?

High level asks:
- Confirm data residency (we're US-only)
- Walkthrough of logging/retention and sample export process
- CAIQ question ownership and earliest evidence delivery date

Attached is our internal intake checklist to help triage. Do you have availability Tuesday or Wednesday morning PT?

Alicia — thanks for the note and the inventory. We can do a 45-min kickoff. Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 2027-05-18 10:00–10:45
- Tue 2027-05-18 14:00–14:45
- Wed 2027-05-19 09:00–09:45

I'll have Irene (security/compliance lead) and Marissa (customer success for evidence handoff) on the call. Key things we'll cover in the agenda: scope & region confirmation, logging sample pull windows, CAIQ mapping and owners, and evidence upload/runbook.

Quick answers to your asks:
- Data residency: Hosted regions include us-west-2 and us-east-1; we'll confirm which tenant you're on during the call.
- Log sampling: we can provide 7–14 day exports; format is gzipped JSONL or CSV depending on the pipeline.

I've attached a short runbook we typically share. If your team can prep a prioritized question set that would speed things up.

—Ethan

Subject: Kickoff notes + action items from SysNova intake (2027-05-18)

Hi Alicia / Tom — thanks for the call this morning. Minutes and agreed actions below. Let me know if I missed anything.

Meeting minutes (45 min):
- Scope: SysNova production tenant in us-west-2 only. Confirmed that customer data never leaves chosen region by default.
- Evidence types & owners:
  - Encryption at rest: Irene to provide KMS key policy screenshots and statement of tenant-level encryption (deliver by 2027-05-20).
  - Auth logs: Marissa/Soojin to provide a 7-day redacted sample today and 30-day export by 2027-05-21 (S3 presigned link).
  - Key rotation notice: Irene to provide last rotated key log + rotation policy doc (2027-05-20).
  - CAIQ mapping: Ethan/Irene to deliver a filled CAIQ spreadsheet with owners flagged by question (2027-05-21).
- Upload & access: Marissa created Drive folder and shared read-only link to SysNova. For large exports we'll provide presigned S3 (72-hr expiry).
- Follow-ups: SysNova to confirm if they need SOC 2 Type 2 documentation or a scoped readiness packet only.

Attachments uploaded to Drive: draft-intake-ma-template.docx; redwood-log-sample-instructions.pdf; SysNova_SIG_inventory.xlsx (we'll add the 24-hour sample and the CAIQ mapping by Friday).

Action items (owners & due dates):
1) Irene: KMS screenshots + rotation doc — due 2027-05-20
2) Marissa & Soojin: 7-day redacted auth-log sample (uploaded) + 30-day export presigned S3 — sample uploaded by 2027-05-18 07:00 PT, full export by 2027-05-21
3) Ethan & Irene: completed CAIQ spreadsheet (owners flagged) — due 2027-05-21
4) SysNova (Alicia/Tom): confirm SOC 2 Type 2 vs readiness packet by 2027-05-19

Please reply-all with any corrections.

Thanks,
